title: The gh-write guard reads a gh command whose repo flag comes before the subcommand
why: Coordinator 10:04 CST Nov 9, from #2444 (gh-write-cloud guard, step gh-search-only): `gh pr -R o/r comment` is allowed, because gh_call_of stops at the -R flag. Harm: a cloud session can post a PR comment outside the merge tool, which the guard is meant to refuse.
note: Fix: gh_call_of skips -R/--repo and its value before the subcommand. It changes the local verdict too, so it runs in its own lane, with a red row first. The coordinator starts the lane after batch 68 merges. Source note gh-write-repo-flag-gap in roadmap/outbox/triage.md. Batch 68 merged (#2449, 11:55 CST Nov 9): free to start.
